title: Not So Creeping Vines
description: A much needed mod to stop vine growth and ticks!
body:
### Description
Have you ever built your bases in jungles, swamps and even lush caves and put so much time and effort into your creations, just for it all to amount to a whopping 20 fps after a day in these biomes? "Not So Creeping Vines" will let you keep your awesome builds without those pesky vines or glowberries destorying your pc one _tick_ at a time. This mod will stop the inifite growth of plants in your world, while still allowing manual growth, and better it yet its configurable!
